payload.title: Deploy hard-decisions.anth.us automatically through DevOps, like Biased-Decisions
payload.description: hard-decisions.anth.us deploys only by hand: tools/deploy_site.sh builds site/dist and uploads a zip to Amplify app da7a84vbkxuhu, and the repository has no git remote at all. Biased-Decisions deploys through a GitHub Actions workflow (.github/workflows/site.yml) on push to main. Bring Hard-Decisions to the same shape: a GitHub remote under AnthusAI, a site workflow that builds, tests, and deploys on push to main, and retire the manual zip path. Found 2026-10-09 when the client-pitch block merged to main could not be deployed because the SSO token for the legacy profile had expired.
